description: Sheng board identities for the 24A446 kernel that order and shape matching stopped pairing. The workflow copies this file into kits/XnuPrelink/fixtures before the package step.

functions.evidence: Reads DAIF and returns 0 when IRQ, FIQ or SError is unmasked; otherwise loads thread->machine.CpuDatap from tpidr_el1 (+0x1b8), then cpu_int_state (+0xd0), and returns whether it is non-NULL. Source: osfmk/arm/machine_routines_common.c ml_at_interrupt_context. The release reference _ml_at_interrupt_context has the same 13 instructions except the CpuDatap offset (+0x1b0). It sits between sched_perfcontrol_ml_set_interrupts_without_measurement and ml_stack_remaining in both images. Callers: AppleUSBXHCI and IOPCIFamily (package run 44664988530).
